skills.name: Day and night, seasons and living things

worked_example.problem: An owl hunts rats at night and sleeps during the day. What kind of animal is it, and why does hunting at night help?
steps: Animals active at night are nocturnal.
Rats come out at night, and the owl sees and hears well in the dark.
worked_example.answer: Nocturnal; it can catch rats that are active at night.

cards.idea: Diurnal animals are active by day; nocturnal animals are active at night.
example: Bats and owls are nocturnal; butterflies are diurnal.

cards.idea: Plants make food only in light, but respire day and night.
example: At night a plant uses some of the food it made in the day.

cards.idea: In the dry season some trees lose leaves, grass dries and animals move to find water.
example: Herders move their cattle south in the dry season to find grass.

check.prompt: Why do some trees lose their leaves in the dry season?

wrong.explain: They grow new leaves when the rains come.
The leaves make food from sunlight; they drop them to save water.
The reason is to save water.
Cameroon’s dry season is not cold; the reason is water.

questions.prompt: Sort these animals: diurnal (day) or nocturnal (night)?
When do green plants make food by photosynthesis?

wrong.explain: They make food whenever there is light, water and air.
They need light; water comes from the soil.

pick.why: The rainy season: farmers plant maize and groundnuts.

pick.t: the grass dries and turns brown
pick.why: The dry season: the grass dries and turns brown.
The rainy season: many mosquitoes breed in puddles.

pick.t: herders move cattle to find grass and water
pick.why: The dry season: herders move cattle to find grass and water.
The dry season: some trees lose their leaves.

misconceptions.explain: Think: lots of water, or little water?

questions.prompt: One sentence is wrong. Which one?

right.text: Many farmers plant at the start of the rains.
Grass dries in the dry season.

wrong.text: Plants make food by photosynthesis at night.
Mosquitoes increase in the dry season.
wrong.explain: They breed in water, so they increase in the rainy season.
